item.title: Seven States Competing, One Epic Weekend: 40 Champions Crowned at EDP Winter Classic
item.description: EDP Soccer concluded its 2025 Tournament Calendar over the weekend with the EDP Winter Classic. The event included over 230 teams, representing 7 different States with 40 champions being crowned across U11-U19 Boys and Girls Divisions.

item.title: Celebrating the Futsal State Cup Maryland 2026 Champions
item.description: The 2026 EDP Futsal State Cup Maryland concluded over the weekend, with seven teams being crowned champions. Top 9U-12U Boys and Girls teams competed in Catonsville, with Bethesda SC leading the way with the most state championships.

item.title: The First Phase of 2026 NJYS Futsal Championships was a Thriller
item.description: On Saturday, January 17, 2026, premier youth futsal teams from across the region gathered at Iron Peak Sports & Events to kick off the 2026 New Jersey Youth Soccer Futsal Championships. This annual winter event sits as one of the state’s most competitive indoor futsal tournaments, giving boys and girls squads from U14 through U19 the first opportunity of the weekend to compete for top honors in fast-paced, 5-a-side futsal action.

item.title: Quick Feet & Pure Passion at the 8U-13U NJYS Futsal Championships
item.description: This weekend saw U8-U13 Boys teams take the court at the New Jersey Youth Soccer Futsal Championships at Iron Peak Sports & Events in Hillsborough, NJ. Top futsal programs from around the region competed, with 10 top teams being crowned champions.

item.title: Top Moments from an Action Packed Spring Kickoff PA 2026
Hundreds of Teams Converge for Competitive Action at EDP Spring Classic Boys 2026
item.description: This weekend, EDP Soccer completed the EDP Spring Classic, with the EDP Spring Classic Boys, hosting over 380 teams. More than 130 clubs were in attendance, from New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, Connecticut, Massachusetts, Maryland, Vermont, Delaware, Rhode Island, Virginia, and Ontario. In total, 59 Champions were crowned on Sunday across Tuckahoe Turf Farms, Green Branch Park, WSFS Bank Sportsplex, and Maria Gatta Community Park.
